cfg_str:
seed: 39590
task:
  _target_: carps.utils.task.Task
  name: bbob/2/1/0
  seed: ${seed}
  objective_function:
    _target_: carps.objective_functions.bbob.BBOBObjectiveFunction
    dimension: 2
    fid: 1
    instance: 0
    seed: ${seed}
  input_space:
    _target_: carps.utils.task.InputSpace
    configuration_space:
      _target_: ConfigSpace.configuration_space.ConfigurationSpace.from_serialized_dict
      _convert_: object
      d:
        name: null
        hyperparameters:
        - type: uniform_float
          name: x0
          lower: -5.0
          upper: 5.0
          default_value: 0.0
          log: false
          meta: null
        - type: uniform_float
          name: x1
          lower: -5.0
          upper: 5.0
          default_value: 0.0
          log: false
          meta: null
        conditions: []
        forbiddens: []
        python_module_version: 1.2.0
        format_version: 0.4
    fidelity_space:
      _target_: carps.utils.task.FidelitySpace
      is_multifidelity: false
      fidelity_type: null
      min_fidelity: null
      max_fidelity: null
    instance_space: null
  output_space:
    _target_: carps.utils.task.OutputSpace
    n_objectives: 1
    objectives:
    - quality
  optimization_resources:
    _target_: carps.utils.task.OptimizationResources
    n_trials: 77
    time_budget: null
    n_workers: 1
  metadata:
    _target_: carps.utils.task.TaskMetadata
    has_constraints: false
    domain: synthetic
    objective_function_approximation: real
    has_virtual_time: false
    deterministic: true
    dimensions: 2
    search_space_n_categoricals: 0
    search_space_n_ordinals: 0
    search_space_n_integers: 0
    search_space_n_floats: 2
    search_space_has_conditionals: false
    search_space_has_forbiddens: false
    search_space_has_priors: false
benchmark_id: BBOB
task_id: ${task.name}
optimizer:
  _target_: carps.optimizers.smac20.SMAC3Optimizer
  _partial_: true
  smac_cfg:
    scenario:
      seed: ${seed}
      n_trials: ${task.optimization_resources.n_trials}
      objectives: ${task.output_space.objectives}
      deterministic: true
      n_workers: 1
      output_directory: ${outdir}/${seed}/smac3_output
      min_budget: ${task.input_space.fidelity_space.min_fidelity}
      max_budget: ${task.input_space.fidelity_space.max_fidelity}
    smac_kwargs:
      dask_client: null
      overwrite: true
    smac_class: smac.facade.blackbox_facade.BlackBoxFacade
optimizer_id: SMAC3-BlackBoxFacade
optimizer_container_id: SMAC3
pyexperimenter_configuration_file_path: null
database_credential_file_path: null
use_special_conda_env: false
conda_env_name: carps_${benchmark_id}_${optimizer_container_id}
timestamp: ${now:%Y-%m-%d}/${now:%H-%M-%S}
baserundir: reference_performance
outdir: ${baserundir}/${optimizer_id}/${benchmark_id}/${task_id}/${seed}
loggers:
- _target_: carps.loggers.file_logger.FileLogger
  _partial_: true
  overwrite: true
- _target_: carps.loggers.database_logger.DatabaseLogger
  _partial_: true
